participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

site.Description: Acquisition site, as coded by the source.

collection.Description: Source collection (TCIA collection, '<collection>_Additional', or anonymized 'Collection N').

tcia_patient_id.Description: PatientID in the source TCIA collection (for overlap with upenn_gbm / ucsf_pdgm). Formats differ by collection (UCSF-PDGM: bare number; UPENN-GBM: scan ID). UCSF-PDGM IDs 138, 175, 181, 278, 315 are pre-v3 IDs of follow-up exams, renamed in UCSF-PDGM v3.

study_date.Description: Study date (some cases), as de-identified by TCIA (dates are shifted, so they are not real calendar dates). The crosswalk mixes Excel dates and m/d/yyyy text; written as YYYY-MM-DD.

mgmt.Description: MGMT promoter methylation (Task 2 target; also given for some non-Task-2 cases).
